12	- A note-INDEPENDENT half: a scenario that carries at least one trigger but has none that are operational-shaped fails the gate (if the scenario is directional) or is downgraded (if it is not), regardless of any note or theme input.
13	
14	ADR-0064 (the Feed chunk cutover) deleted the note producer system: there is no `note_state`, no `theme.support_class`, and no validate step left to feed the note-derived half. That half necessarily went with the note system. Separately, ticket C5 (part of the same cutover work) deleted the whole gate module as collateral damage while removing the note-coupled pipeline, taking the note-independent half down with it even though nothing about that half depended on notes. Ticket C8 (commit `e6df779a`) reinstates only the note-independent half, as a new, smaller, purely deterministic module: `pipeline/src/agents/pipeline/scenario-trigger-gate.ts`.
